Days Health & Beauty
(established 2018 in Baddi, Himachal Pradesh) is a major Indian contract manufacturer and private-label partner specializing in Ayurvedic, cosmetic, FSSAI nutrition, and veterinary goods. They provide third-party production for prominent consumer brands like Oziva (HUL), Medplus, and Himalayan Organics.
www.dayshnb.com
Core Product Brands & Offerings
Ayurvedic & Herbal:
Day’s Shilajit Capsules
Day’s Panax Ginseng Capsules
Choco Shilajit Sachets
, and
Ashwagandha Capsules
Personal Care & Cosmetics:
Herbal/medicated soaps, daily face washes, shampoos, conditioners, moisturizers, serums, and facial kits.
Nutritional & Resins:
FSSAI-compliant dietary supplements and purified mineral resins.
www.dayshnb.com
Key Manufacturing Partners & Clients
Oziva (Hul)
Medplus
Himalayan Organics
Thrive Co
Sesa, Richfeel, and Vivaldis
